evals.prompt: Why am I getting inconsistent datatype error with COALESCE in SAP HANA SQL?
evals.expected_output: Explains that SAP HANA requires matching datatypes in COALESCE arguments and advises using explicit type casting like TO_VARCHAR or CAST.

assertions.description: Mentions type casting or matching datatype

evals.prompt: How do I avoid column collision when joining two tables in SAP HANA Go driver?
evals.expected_output: Explains that drivers map scan columns by name and requires explicit column aliases on joins instead of SELECT *.
